# limen_documents (Data Source)

Lists policy documents of one kind, in name order, all from one policy version even while others write. A bot writer sees only its own namespace (and the profiles its grant names).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "limen_documents" "staging_dbs" {
  kind   = "resource"
  labels = { team = "payments", env = "staging" }
}

output "staging_dbs" {
  value = data.limen_documents.staging_dbs.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) The kind: one of `role`, `role_mapping`, `resource`, `bot`, `discovery`, `policy_test`, `resource_profile`, `policy_writer`.

### Optional

- `labels` (Map of String) Only documents carrying all of these labels (matched against their effective labels).
- `namespace` (String) Only documents in this namespace.
- `source` (String) Only documents owned by this source.

### Read-Only

- `documents` (Attributes List) The documents, in name order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--documents))
- `names` (List of String) The documents' names, in order.
- `policy_version` (Number) The policy version the listing was read from.

<a id="nestedatt--documents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `documents`

Read-Only:

- `channel` (String) `git`, `console`, or `api`.
- `description` (String) Free text.
- `effective_labels` (Map of String) What roles select on.
- `effective_spec_json` (String) What enforcement uses, as JSON.
- `etag` (String) The current etag.
- `labels` (Map of String) The labels its writer set.
- `name` (String) The name.
- `namespace` (String) The owner's namespace.
- `policy_version` (Number) The version this revision first appeared in.
- `profile` (String) For a resource, the profile it completes.
- `source` (String) The owner's source.
- `spec_json` (String) The spec its writer set, as JSON.
- `updated_at` (String) When this revision was written.
- `updated_by` (String) Who wrote this revision.
